variantLabel: v11 shadow: inner-right extended, offset forward
variantNote: v10's row shadow stopped at the row's right edge. v11 gives each group its own spreads: the hand row widens both ends by 0.15 units (so its right shadow passes the last tile), the drawn tile widens only outward (0.28 units, well past the hand) and keeps its gap side at its tile edge, so the tsumogiri gap still dips between the two blobs. The whole footprint is offset 0.06 units forward (south) so the shadow does not look like it surrounds the tiles perfectly evenly; the x blur is 0.10.

ambientOcclusion.note: Cycles path-traced global illumination produces the soft contact shadow under every tile base and the crevice darkening between neighbours; no post AO pass and no Eevee AO setting exists in this engine.

handLightingCheat.note: v3: the hand's geometry keeps the 40 deg cheat so the faces read, and every hand material still shades as the 12 deg physical pose. Unlike v2, the cast shadow is now also the physical pose's (rig.variants['v3-hand-shadow'].handShadow), so the shading and the shadow both read as a normally seated tile.

handShadow.falloff: gaussian-like smoothstep on all four edges, 2 sigma
handShadow.note: One blurred contact rectangle per group, all four edges (sigma 0.28 depth / 0.10 x), 0.5 alpha on every edge. Spreads per group: hand row 0.15 both ends, drawn tile 0 left / 0.28 right; the whole rect is offset 0.06 units south and its north edge sits 0.5 units under the tiles.

hand.note: v3: the shared 8.8 radius applies to the three opponent hands; only the player's (bottom) hand moves back to 9.3, a further half tile height (0.5 units) from the wall. The player's drawn tile moves with it. The tilt stays the 40 deg readability cheat, shaded as the 12 deg physical pose.

meld.note: v2: one four-slot meld row per seat at the hand's new radius 8.8 (v1: 10.6), to the right of the player's hand; the drawn tile ends at x 5.58 and the row starts at x 6.1. Slots 0-1 upright, slot 2 the called tile lying sideways, slot 3 the kan extension.

handFace.localZ: paint face (the rig scene forces 5z here)

camera.note: Shadow take: the framing lifts 19 px (Shift Y -0.03 instead of -0.02) so the longer gradient has lit felt below it and never reaches the frame edge. Everything else is v4.

output.note: The plan's reference resolution. One render per variant, not a @2x master: the rig is a perspective/lighting calibration target, and Task 3 exports normalized screen coordinates and quads, not pixels from a board. Committed variants live together under reference/rig/ so they can be A/B compared; {variant} is the variant id.

lighting.convention: A large soft overhead AREA key slightly forward of table centre (toward the camera) plus three low-intensity AREA fills, one from the near/south side for the standing hand and two low side fills for the side-wall inner vertical faces. Cycles path-traced GI supplies the contact occlusion and soft shadows under the tile bases (there is no Eevee AO toggle in the Cycles engine). The key is neutral warm and the fills are cool so the bevels and inner faces read against the ivory body without tinting the face paint.

key.note: v2: dimmed from the 9000 W baseline so the discard faces stop reading as blown-out white. Same position, size and colour.

fills.note: Near/south fill: lights the player's standing hand fronts and the south-facing inner faces of the far wall; cool and low so it only opens the shadows.
Left side fill: defines the west wall's inner vertical faces and the left bevels.
Right side fill: mirrors the left fill for the east wall's inner vertical faces and the right bevels.

world.note: Ambient sky at the shell baker's world tint, low strength; with film transparent it still lights the scene but does not write a background.

render.colorManagement: table-reference scene block (sRGB, AgX, AgX - Medium High Contrast, exposure 0)
render.note: Film > Transparent plus the room floor hidden: the published PNG is RGBA with a transparent surround, so the board can be composited and the alpha is a checkable fact. The mat, rim, centre well and every tile stay opaque. 64 samples with adaptive sampling and OpenImageDenoise is the smallest count that leaves the bevelled edges clean at 1920 x 1080.

samples.note: Pixel probes for the lighting facts. The pond's 5z face (the faces.sampleTileId) and the wall's blue back are the same probes the placement reference uses, so the rig can be compared with the shipped shells. hand-bottom-06 is forced to 5z in the rig scene only, giving a known blank ivory hand face (the near-fill read). The side probes average the pixels inside each side wall's projected inner vertical face (a single pixel would spill at 3.8 px wide). matWorldPoint is open felt between the north pond and the north wall: the north wall stands farther from the camera, so it cannot occlude the probe, and the point is clear of tile shadows (the near strip behind the south wall is occluded by the wall's own top at a 50 deg pitch).

southWallFace.note: A row of probes on the south wall's outer vertical face at z = 0.1, inside and outside the player's hand span (the hand covers |x| <= 5). The hand's fill shadow on this wall is the give-away the shadow cheat removes, so the checker compares the centre probe with the two end probes: a uniform row (small dip) means nothing is cast on the wall. Informational for variants without the cheat.

handShadow.note: Felt probes south of the player's hand's front edge, on the mat at x = 0: 50, 150, 250, 400 and 600 thousandths of a unit from the tile's front edge. The last is the local lit-felt reference; a gradient shadow must stay above a floor at the closest probe and be essentially gone by the fade distance. Informational for variants without a decal.

checks.note: Thresholds are the acceptance criteria of the plan's Task 2, in numbers: perspective + 75 mm + 50 deg + X = 0 + negative shift, the full table width inside the frame, the south hand near the bottom, no inward vertical lean and at most maxOutwardLeanPx of outward lean, side-wall inner faces at least wallInnerFaceMinPx wide, the centre hand tile straight-on and the outer hand tiles showing a sliver, and a lit ivory face / blue back / readable hand face / lit inner side face in the render.
